deviceAgent.agentStalled: Agent stalled — what is below may be out of date.
deviceAgent.agentStopped: Agent stopped — nothing reaches its folders or ports.

deviceDetail.asleepNote: Nobody was using it, so this computer put it to sleep. Opening it wakes it.
deviceDetail.deviceIsntSyncingFolder: This device isn't syncing a folder or holding any ports for this sandbox.
deviceDetail.noFolderDeviceOnly: no folder: this device only mirrors ports
deviceDetail.offDeviceIsntPutting: Off: this device isn't putting this sandbox's ports on its own localhost. File syncing is unaffected.
deviceDetail.interruptedUpdate: interrupted update — Start puts it back
deviceDetail.interruptedUpdateHint: An update was interrupted and the previous version set aside: Start puts it back.
deviceDetail.idleHint: Sandboxes that run on other computers, or no longer exist, whose files and ports don't reach this one now: their syncing is paused or stopped. Unpair or remove them from their ⋯ menu.
deviceDetail.buildOutputOnDevice: build output left on this device
deviceDetail.buildOutputInSandbox: build output left in the sandbox
deviceDetail.derivedLead: One directory the sandbox deleted is still here, held open by build output this device never syncs (node_modules, dist, a build cache). Nothing of yours is in it: clearing it lets that deletion land. | {count} directories the sandbox deleted are still here, held open by build output this device never syncs (node_modules, dist, a build cache). Nothing of yours is in them: clearing it lets those deletions land.
deviceDetail.disputedLead: One path changed both on this device and in the sandbox since they last agreed, so neither copy was overwritten and it has stopped syncing. Make the two copies match — same contents, or gone on both sides — and syncing resumes on its own. | {count} paths changed both on this device and in the sandbox since they last agreed, so neither copy was overwritten and they have stopped syncing. Make the two copies match — same contents, or gone on both sides — and syncing resumes on its own.
deviceDetail.derivedAndDisputedLead: {lead} The other one is a real disagreement: both ends hold their own copy. | {lead} The other {count} are real disagreements: both ends hold their own copy.
deviceDetail.portsBusyHere: {count} port busy here | {count} ports busy here
deviceDetail.portsLeftAlone: {count} port left alone | {count} ports left alone
deviceDetail.portsTakenByOther: {count} port taken by another sandbox | {count} ports taken by another sandbox
deviceDetail.portsOnLocalhost: {count} port on localhost: {numbers} | {count} ports on localhost: {numbers}
deviceDetail.adoptedFrom: looked after from here: {side} went quiet
deviceDetail.portLeftAlone: not on localhost: left alone on purpose
deviceDetail.portBusy: not on localhost: another program here already uses it

imageView.imagePreviewCtrlScroll: Image preview: Ctrl and scroll to zoom, drag to pan

markdownDocument.overLimit: {over} character over the {max}-character limit | {over} characters over the {max}-character limit

sandboxDeviceDetail.devicesAgentDoesntReport: This device's agent doesn't report which paths they are. Updating it lists them here.

sandboxResourcesDialog.applyingRestartsSandboxOnto: Applying restarts the sandbox onto the same image, about a minute, and interrupts whoever is working in it. Its files (in /work) are kept, and the new share survives every later update, rollback and rebuild.
sandboxResourcesDialog.askedComputerNoNvidia: Asked for, but this computer has no NVIDIA container runtime, so the sandbox runs without it.
sandboxResourcesDialog.cpusAtLeast: At least {min} CPUs: a sandbox needs a core to run on.
sandboxResourcesDialog.cpusAtMost: At most {max} CPUs on this computer: that is every core its engine has.
sandboxResourcesDialog.cpusWhole: Whole CPUs, {bounds} on this computer. Empty is no limit: every core it has.
sandboxResourcesDialog.fullAccessToComputers: Full access to this computer's devices and kernel, the way a nested Docker engine needs. Only for a tool that cannot run without it.
sandboxResourcesDialog.locked: Your approved environment requires this, so it can't be turned off here.
sandboxResourcesDialog.memoryAtLeast: At least {min} GiB: below that the sandbox's own toolchain stops fitting.
sandboxResourcesDialog.memoryAtMost: At most {max} GiB on this computer.
sandboxResourcesDialog.memoryWhole: Whole GiB, at least {min}. Empty is the default: everything this computer has beyond what it keeps for itself.
sandboxResourcesDialog.memoryWholeOf: Whole GiB, at least {min}. Docker on this computer has {engine} GiB, so a higher cap is no cap at all. Empty is the default: everything it has beyond what it keeps for itself.
sandboxResourcesDialog.passComputersNvidiaGpus: Pass this computer's NVIDIA GPUs into the sandbox: the driver rides in with them.
sandboxResourcesDialog.sandboxUsingRightNow: This is the sandbox you are using right now: this page will lose it until it is back.
sandboxResourcesDialog.savedForNextRestart: Saved for the next restart: {share}. The fields show it; Apply now restarts onto it straight away.
sandboxResourcesDialog.savingKeepsItRunning: Saving keeps the sandbox running as it is. ic keeps the new share and applies it on the sandbox's next restart through ic: Restart here, Start, an update, a rollback or a rebuild. Docker restarting the container by itself, after a crash or a reboot, does not apply it.

sandboxSandboxVerbs.deletesSandboxEverythingIn: This removes the sandbox and everything in it (its files and its history) from that device. It stays recoverable there for a week: `ic sandbox restore` on that machine brings it back.
sandboxSandboxVerbs.sandboxRestartsOntoImage: The sandbox restarts onto the image it ran before its last update. Its files are kept.
sandboxSandboxVerbs.sandboxRestartsOntoNewest: The sandbox restarts onto the newest image and is unavailable while that happens — seconds if the update is already downloaded, a few minutes if not. Its files are kept.
sandboxSandboxVerbs.sandboxRestartsOntoVersion: The sandbox restarts onto {version}, an older version this machine kept. Its files are kept.

portPreview.lapsed: The forward for port {port} has lapsed: re-open the preview from the Ports view.
portPreview.noPublicHostname: This sandbox has no public preview hostname, so ports can't be previewed from the browser.
portPreview.unreachable: {url} doesn't reach this sandbox: the address may still be propagating, or this sandbox publishes no preview hostnames. Close this tab and try again.
